caption: Arch of Trajan, Benevento
composition: Freestanding Roman triumphal arch with carved attic reliefs on a paved square · AI-generated artistic interpretation
description: The freestanding triumphal arch dominates the center of the frame, seen from the paved square. Its carved attic panels and relief-covered piers rise above the single great archway, the weathered marble glowing in the sun. Town palazzi flank the view at the left and right, with a few pedestrians crossing the square. The modelled scenario is 23 September 2026 at 12:28 Europe/Rome: bright midday sun under a clear blue sky.
